title: Provider-neutral decision answer
description: One normalized answer from a decision model (SubQ Snap or TypeSafe Jev) to one question of SNAP_QUESTIONS.json, as written by evaltools.decision_models.normalize and read by evaltools.compare_evaluators. Version 1.0.0.

model_requested.description: The model id sent in the request, pinned (subq-snap-1.1, jev-1.14.0).

model_reported.description: The model id the reply named; may differ from an alias.

value.description: noul: probability of yes (0-1); choice: the chosen option; score: the probability-weighted level, which may fall between levels.

confidence.description: The service's own confidence for choice and score; for a noul, how far the probability sits from one half scaled to 0-1 (a sorting aid, not calibration).

cost_usd.description: input_tokens times the provider's listed input price; output is free for both services.

answer_file.description: A *.answers.json file holds {tags, answers, raw_reply, answered_at}. tags carry provider, model_requested, item_id, question_ids, questions, rubric_version, commit_sha, state_digest, state_tokens_estimate, state_budget_tokens, state_trimmed and built_at; answers is a list of records in this schema (an answer the service omitted has value null and an error string instead).

agreement_rules.noul: agree when both probabilities are on the same side of 0.5, or within 0.2 of each other
agreement_rules.choice: agree when the chosen options are equal
agreement_rules.score: agree when the weighted levels are within 0.5 of each other
agreement_rules.reference: a reviewer's expected answer matches by the same rules (noul: side of 0.5 against a boolean)
